scope: Posterior comparison only; not permission or registration to read on-source strain
known_information: Published central GW250114 constraints and older catalogue/V2 values were already read. Selection and hypotheses are NOT BLIND.

primary.parameters: joint fractional df220,dtau220; actual key names and prior must be inspected

secondary: pyRing TEOB 220 variants; robustness only, not independent evidence
duplicate_policy: One primary likelihood contribution per physical event, prefer current cumulative release; never multiply the GW250114 standalone likelihood again if included in catalogue

exclusion_rule.scope: Operational decision rule, not universal statistical definition of exclusion

KDE.dimensions: joint df,dtau plus spin when prediction depends on it; mass/redshift added only for non-negligible mass-dependent corrections
KDE.tail_policy: No strong exclusion from unsupported KDE tails; require stability and effective local support

priors.point_models: Retain common nuisance prior from release; divide by actual broad-model deformation prior at each restricted point
priors.mass_dependent_bounds: Conditional prior given source mass, explicitly normalized

spin_dependent_model_identity: Z_L/Z_broad = integral p_broad(eta,delta=g_L(eta)|d)/pi_broad(delta=g_L(eta)|eta) d eta, for matched nuisance prior. Bayes ratio is ratio of these integrals, NOT a posterior mean of pointwise conditional ratios.
small_correction_policy: Below 1e-6 report analytic scale and numerical indistinguishability at posterior resolution; no false precision in logB
unresolved_mapping: Propagation, global noise and coherent-root cases require their own physical observables; no arbitrary deterministic damping assignment
